monitors.resolved_description:
Push power switch when there is radio wave interference

The electrical key for vehicles with a multi-channel system has a two-channel frequency. When noise interference affects the key's RF radio wave, the frequency switches to another channel.
When pushing power switch operation fails, this log was recorded.

NOTE 1: When this log is recorded one time:
The frequency was switched, and then the system worked properly.
NOTE 2: When this log is recorded repeatedly:
There was wideband radio wave interference or a system malfunction.

[Details]
 -Temporary response failed, CH1

New Key registration interrupted: Except Vehicle ID NG

An attempt was made to register a new key (an unregistered key) by holding it to the power switch, but registration was not possible due to noise or a failing key battery. 

The key registration was interrupted after one or more of the key's registration was completed. (ECU code registration completed)
It interrupted by registration condition failure that depends besides the following reason.
 -Operation of registration end request by technician
 -Lost communication with Techstream
 -Timeout
